verdicts.rationale: All three members share title 'Maps, Pictures, and Predication', author Kulvicki, 2015, Ergo vol 2, and DOI 10.3998/ergo.12405314.0002.007. kulvicki2015b just adds pages 149-74 (same DOI). Only survivor is indexed. Identical work.

Same OUP book, identical ISBN 9780198847472. kulvicki2020modelling is a British-spelling ('Modelling') variant of the same title/edition with matching ISBN/publisher/year; survivor and it are both deepIndexed but genuinely identical edition. Kulvicki2020 shares the DOI. Merge OK.
Both are the same 2018 PhD thesis 'Parts of Perception' by Lande, Kevin Joseph. california2018parts is a shadow/duplicate import (both deepIndexed) with identical title/author/year. Identical work.

All three share title 'The Perspectival Character of Perception', Lande, 2018, J. Philosophy 115(4), pp 187-214, DOI 10.5840/jphil2018115413. Only survivor indexed. Identical work (journal name 'The Journal of Philosophy' vs 'Journal of Philosophy' cosmetic).

All four share title 'Mental structures', Lande, 2021, Noûs 55(3), pp 649-677, DOI 10.1111/nous.12324. Survivor and lande2021mental both deepIndexed with identical fields (citekey year differs, actual year is 2021 in both). Identical work.
Both share title 'Contours of Vision: Towards a Compositional Semantics of Perception', Lande, 2026, BJPS, DOI 10.1086/725094. Lande2026 is a Zotero-style duplicate of the survivor. Identical work.
Both share title 'The Imagery Debate Exhumed and Reanimated', Langland-Hassan, 2025, BJPS, DOI 10.1086/737739, same forthcoming note. LanglandHassan2025 is a Zotero-style duplicate. Identical work.

All three share title 'Segmented Discourse Representation Theory: Dynamic Semantics with Discourse Structure', Lascarides & Asher, 2008, Computing Meaning, pp 87-124, DOI 10.1007/978-1-4020-5958-2_5. Only survivor indexed. Identical work.

All three share title 'A Formal Semantic Analysis of Gesture', authors Lascarides & Stone, 2009, J. Semantics 26(4), pp 393-449, DOI 10.1093/jos/ffp004. Survivor deepIndexed and stone2009formal indexed are identical (stone2009formal is a first-author-swap citekey for the same paper). Identical work.

Both share title 'Empirical support for higher-order theories of conscious awareness', Lau & Rosenthal, 2011, TiCS 15(8), pp 365-373, DOI 10.1016/j.tics.2011.05.009. Lau2011 is a Zotero-style duplicate. Identical work.

Both share title 'Confused Thought and Modes of Presentation', Lawlor, 2005, Phil. Quarterly 55(218), pp 21-36, DOI 10.1111/j.0031-8094.2005.00382.x. Lawlor2005 is a Zotero-style duplicate. Identical work.

Both share title 'Dynamic coding of border-ownership in visual cortex', authors Layton, Mingolla & Yazdanbakhsh, 2012, J. Vision 12(13), DOI 10.1167/12.13.8. Layton2012 is a Zotero-style duplicate. Identical work.
